membership_and_aliases.duplicate_policy: Compare canonicalized full input plus complete options, including glossary, backend and default flags; report text-only equality separately. period_policy.whole_hour: NAOJ: 午前12時 and 午後0時 express noon; 午前0時 and 午後12時 express midnight. Its historical-definition qualification for 午後0時 is recorded, not used to mislabel all four as ambiguous. No English AM/PM mapping.
period_policy.minutes: NAOJ warns 午前12 plus minutes can be interpreted as midday or midnight. The B26 reference explicitly expresses uncertainty between both source-supported readings of one meeting time. The wording was independently reviewed for reference drafting under the issue 133 policy; full-bank adoption remains pending. Do not force one reading, assert an intentional scheduling choice, or invent context. A technical no-invention guard alone is not a full quality pass.
period_policy.4_5_boundary: For 1–4 explicit 午前, 凌晨 is a proposed Taiwan usage; 5–11 上午 is proposed. This is a conventional wording judgment, not a hard law; checker must review whole and half cases. PM 1–11 should preserve afternoon, event and hour.
period_policy.zero_twenty_four: Use D at 24:00 and D+1 at 00:00 for the same boundary; retain each stated day association. This data guard does not implement date conversion. Bare 13:00 and 23:00 test representative valid values, not universal coverage.
period_policy.background: https://www.nao.ac.jp/faq/a0401.html; factual background only; no copied sentences or dictionary references.

portable_options_and_spans.api: analyze_and_translate(source, TranslateOptions::new(TargetVariant::ZhHant), &TranslationGlossary, None, Backend::Onnx), with default localize_entities=false, cjk_latin_spacing=false and other defaults from schema.rs; no caller-supplied arbitrary opaque span field. CLI translate --target zh-Hant --format json --glossary <fixture> supplies JSON TranslationGlossary; source_hint and other flags fixed explicitly at fixture freeze. Do not run either before data adoption.
portable_options_and_spans.glossary: domain_terms entry canonical and surfaces bound to intended source fragment; targets map ZhHant to an independently authored explicit target. For whole clock, replacement must express same time; for partial fixtures retain the exact matched source fragment as target where needed to avoid forcing an unnatural mixed natural translation. Record exact surface, replacement, full options and source case in each final row. Canonical and target are distinct fields; explicitly set all.
portable_options_and_spans.matching: glossary.rs uses leftmost-longest exact matching and ASCII alphanumeric edge guards. Japanese fragments here have non-ASCII edges and are eligible by source-level matcher; actual segmentation, placeholder application and behavior unverified. Opaque spans block overlapping glossary; inline opaque has priority 0, glossary 1, entities 2. No arbitrary lock combination or executed reachability claimed.
portable_options_and_spans.opaque: Inline backticks express code-like opaque candidates through document segmentation; no public option sets arbitrary character spans. Source must actually contain delimiters, so opaque variants differ from base JP; full segmentation and whether lock intersects clock atoms require later observation. Do not claim byte-range locks can be injected via TranslateOptions.
portable_options_and_spans.span_contract: For every case fix explicit half-open Unicode scalar [start_char,end_char) source and target coordinates against the exact independently fixed source and expected target; compute corresponding UTF-8 byte boundaries separately from these strings. Public API spans are scalar, not bytes. Validate slices, actual encoded bytes, target replacement, each expected lock occurrence, position relative to surrounding arguments and clock, and clause alignment. Dynamic positions if variants differ must be recorded per variant; never invent offsets before wording.
portable_options_and_spans.quality: Lock restoration and span correctness are separate from a complete natural sentence; preserve full reference and semantic constraints without treating an unchanged bad output as a full pass. Partial clocks are deliberate negative safety controls, not evidence of support for rewriting them.
portable_options_and_spans.token_contract: Pairs B07/B08/B09 supply text-form candidates for numeric+時 joined/split analysis. They do not specify or guarantee actual tokenizer/atom shape. After adoption and explicit authorization, capture both shapes where genuinely reachable. If no same-call route can achieve a required shape, report source-bound proof and remaining untested scope rather than invent a fixture.

complete_options_blueprint.entry_default_enums: unspecified where omitted according to typed serde defaults; canonical and surfaces nonempty, targets contains zh-Hant literal; exact complete object frozen before any execution
complete_options_blueprint.constraints: Metadata and byte/scalar spans belong in dataset wrapper, never as invented TranslationGlossary keys. Statically reject unknown keys and wrong schema even though serde may ignore them.

portable_options_and_spans.restoration: Restorer repairs a missing mandatory placeholder but source does not guarantee exact-once: repeated placeholders can each be expanded. Assert separately one corresponding record and occurrence per specified locked source occurrence, exact replacement/opaque bytes, intended location and source/target alignments. Do not assert global substring uniqueness when other occurrences are legitimate.
portable_options_and_spans.full_quality_policy: Each case needs a complete provisional reference; for a partial lock whose mandated literal causes mixed language, record the literal fixture output as an integrity constraint only. If no complete natural translation preserving the exact lock can be defended, mark full-quality expectation explicitly unresolved for independent review, not full success from unchanged mixed output. Contrasting unlocked case remains a full-semantic control.
